description.to:
Outcome: The shared tier runs one newsroom app (the Shadcn /newsroom app, AGENTS.md) at one host, for example newsroom.apyr.us, with a tenant switcher. Reasons: a Cognito app client accepts at most 100 callback URLs, so sign-in cannot live on every tenant's domain; one Google OAuth client; one Amplify app to build (builds cost money). A tenant's own domain answers /newsroom with a redirect to the shared host with the tenant preselected. Staging previews (editor/admin only) work through the shared host.

Touches (verified at origin/develop 23fabe1d): app/newsroom, middleware.ts, amplify/auth/resource.ts (redirect URLs), amplify/auth/redirect-urls.ts, infra/amplify-app-shell, lib/prospectus-tenant.ts, the edge function (the /newsroom redirect).

Acceptance (Gherkin feature file: features/shared-newsroom-host.feature):
Scenario: An editor reaches their tenant's newsroom from the site
    Given Ada edits "alpha" at "alpha.apyr.us"
    When she opens "alpha.apyr.us/newsroom"
    Then she is sent to the shared newsroom with "alpha" selected after Google sign-in

Dependencies: blocked by PPY-0bb0fd, PPY-daf673. Blocks nothing in this plan yet. (Also recorded as kbs dependencies.)
Implements or extends: -.

Testing: Browser tests with two tenants; Google sign-in only.
Rollout: Shared stack only.
Risk and mitigation: Risk: phishing look-alikes of the shared host. Mitigation: one well-known host, documented; no sign-in form on tenant domains.

Releasable on its own: yes.
DynamoDB index: none.
AppSync authorisation: unchanged (uses the claims of PPY-0bb0fd).
Design note: docs/plans/multi-tenant-architecture.md (PR on branch docs/multi-tenant-architecture).
